contribution.position: I hold my earlier position. I am answering qa's claim on axis:risk that queue_depth is 700 items, inside the 1000 budget. That figure does not appear in any listed artifact. artifact:perf-report records 4200 items at peak load against the same 1000 budget, so qa's number is unsupported. Unless qa can point to a different run, such as a non-peak measurement, I treat it as a misreading of the report. Even if 700 were a valid off-peak reading, it would not answer the peak result. The retry-storm exposure in artifact:incident-log is also unaddressed, and no artifact shows the thumbnailer's retry or backoff behavior under overload. I also respond to ops's claim that the runbook covers operations. artifact:ops-runbook documents deploy and rollback steps. That shows recovery is possible, but it does not show the queue stays within budget or that retries are bounded. artifact:test-report (412 passed, 0 failed) has no load or overload evidence behind it. What would change my view is an explanation or fix for the 4200-item peak, or a load test showing bounded retries at that depth.
